metrics_cycle_consistency.name: metrics_cycle_consistency
metrics_cycle_consistency.value:
"metrics"."in_dependency_cycle" IS NULL
          OR "metrics"."cyclic_component_size" IS NULL
          OR (
            "metrics"."in_dependency_cycle" = true
            AND "metrics"."cyclic_component_size" >= 1
          )
          OR (
            "metrics"."in_dependency_cycle" = false
            AND "metrics"."cyclic_component_size" = 0
          )

repositories_github_metadata_check.name: repositories_github_metadata_check
repositories_github_metadata_check.value:
"repositories"."source_type" <> 'github'
          OR (
            "repositories"."github_owner" IS NOT NULL
            AND "repositories"."github_name" IS NOT NULL
            AND "repositories"."canonical_url" IS NOT NULL
          )
